preview.text: Bhutan faces Thailand in a T20 match at Selangor Turf Club, where Thailand won the toss and chose to bat first. Across their 8 recorded T20 meetings, Bhutan won 3 and Thailand won 5. The usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches at Selangor Turf Club is 144, while the forecast for the next 8 hours shows up to a 100 per cent chance of rain and about 33 degrees.

summary.text: Thailand won by 37 runs. THAI made 134-8, Chaloemwong Chatphaisan top-scoring with 37 off 34 balls; Tashi Phuntsho took 2 for 20. BTN made 95-8, Tenjin Rabgey top-scoring with 43 off 43 balls; Nopphon Senamontree took 5 for 10. Sides batting first at Selangor Turf Club usually make about 144.
